strings.en:
This is the era known as S.C.

Nearly two centuries have passed since humanity truly
ventured into space, yet daily life is little changed from
the early 21st century. The reason: the damage and
chaos caused by two fallen meteorites brought human
progress to a temporary halt.

Then came S.C. 179.

A third meteorite, Meteor 3, fell off the Marquesas
Islands in the South Pacific. An Earth Federation
Government survey team found it to be artificial. Sealed
within it was information on materials and technologies
wholly unknown to humanity. Dubbed EOT, they became
the subject of research.

From the results, the brilliant scientist Bian Zoldark
warned the Earth Federation Government and Earth
Federation Army of the danger of invasion by
extraterrestrial intelligent life... In response, work
began on humanoid mobile weapons for fighting aliens,
such as Personal Troopers and Armored Modules.

Later, the military organization DC (Divine Crusaders),
led by Dr. Bian Zoldark, declared war on the Earth
Federation Government, starting a large-scale conflict
called the DC War.

After that, major crises struck the Earth Sphere one
after another: the invasion of aliens called the
Aerogators (the L5 Campaign), attacks by a mysterious
bioweapon swarm called the Einst, the revolt of an
Earth Federation Army special forces unit called
Shadow Mirror, the invasion of aliens called the
Inspectors, the struggle against the Shura, a warrior
band from a parallel world, and more.

Then war broke out with Ruina, a hostile group that
emerged from mysterious ruins beneath the Antarctic
ice, and the Zovorg, aliens who invaded the Earth
Sphere.

The Earth Federation Army repelled its many foes and
won, yet a mysterious giant ring-shaped structure
called the Cross Gate remained in the skies above Earth.

And that gate to another world was beginning to stir
ominously...
